editorial:
Imagine you are a strict, boring teacher who spends all his time following rules until you see a photo of a beautiful cabaret singer. That is exactly what happens to Professor Rath. He goes to a club called The Blue Angel just to catch his students acting out, but he ends up falling head over heels for Lola Lola. The vibe of the movie is a wild ride from a quiet classroom to a smoky, loud nightclub. You get to watch a man completely lose his mind and his dignity because he is so blinded by love for a woman who only cares about money and attention.

What really makes this work is the acting. You can feel the pain on the professor's face as his life falls apart. The pacing is steady, though it feels a bit slow by today's standards. If you like old-school dramas with a sad twist, you will love this. It is a great pick for a movie night if you want something different. You should try renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a movie buff, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: By the end, Rath has lost everything. He spent all his money and his reputation trying to please Lola, but she just laughs at him and treats him like a joke. He ends up broke and brokenhearted. In the final scenes, he is a shell of a man, wandering the streets and begging for attention. He realizes that Lola never loved him, and his obsession completely destroyed his entire life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old movies about obsession and heartbreak.
